candidates.title: User-friendly query designer UI
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for designing queries.
candidates.source_quote: We need a user-friendly interface for designing queries
candidates.priority_signals: Listed as a key request; included in consolidated summary; "This is great."

candidates.title: Query against all record types
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to design and run queries against all record types.
candidates.source_quote: designing queries against all record types
candidates.priority_signals: Listed as a key request in original email and consolidated summary

candidates.title: Select fields to query
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to select which fields to include in a query.
candidates.source_quote: Staff should be able to select fields to query
candidates.priority_signals: Requested by multiple directors; in summary

candidates.title: Picklist value selection in queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to select query values from picklists.
candidates.source_quote: select values from picklists
candidates.priority_signals: Included in original request and consolidated summary

candidates.title: Regular expression support via dropdown
candidates.statement: The system shall support use of regular expressions in queries selectable from a dropdown.
candidates.source_quote: use regular expressions from a dropdown
candidates.priority_signals: Explicitly requested in initial email and summary

candidates.title: Boolean operators in query builder
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Boolean operators for combining query clauses.
candidates.source_quote: use Boolean operators
candidates.priority_signals: Requested by multiple participants; in summary

candidates.title: Admin control of query tool access
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to control access to the query tool.
candidates.source_quote: Admin controls access
candidates.priority_signals: Called out in consolidated summary

candidates.title: Report template creation by admins
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to create report templates that are made available to staff.
candidates.source_quote: Admins need to create report templates that are available to staff
candidates.priority_signals: Key request; "consistency" benefit emphasized

candidates.title: Run templates as-is
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to run a report template as-is without modifying the template.
candidates.source_quote: Templates should be runnable as-is
candidates.priority_signals: Desired to ensure consistent results; mentioned in multiple messages

candidates.title: Modify template instance without altering template
candidates.statement: The system shall allow staff to modify a run-instance of a template without compromising or altering the original template or its results.
candidates.source_quote: Templates should be runnable as-is or modified. Changes shouldn't compromise results.
candidates.priority_signals: Emphasis on consistency; example given about preventing display of deleted items

candidates.title: Limit editable filters and display fields
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to limit which filters and display fields in a template can be altered by staff.
candidates.source_quote: Admins should be able to limit which filters and display fields can be altered
candidates.priority_signals: Explicit example given; included in summary

candidates.title: Clone reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the ability to clone an existing report or template to create a new variant.
candidates.source_quote: We also need the ability to "clone" reports - take an existing template and create a new one based on it.
candidates.priority_signals: Described as a distinct capability from modifying a template

candidates.title: Fine-grained report permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide distinct, fine-grained permission levels that limit who can create and clone reports.
candidates.source_quote: We need distinct, fine-grained permission levels limiting who can create and clone reports.
candidates.priority_signals: Called out as needed; included in summary

candidates.title: Shared folders for report access control
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to create shared folders and assign permissions to allow or disallow staff from running specific reports stored in those folders.
candidates.source_quote: Admins can create shared folders to allow or disallow staff from running specific reports
candidates.priority_signals: Explicit requirement in original email and summary

candidates.title: Shared folders for ad-hoc data set access
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to create shared folders that control whether staff may run ad hoc reports on specific sets of data.
candidates.source_quote: and/or to run ad hoc reports on specific sets of data
candidates.priority_signals: Explicitly mentioned in original email

candidates.title: Easy permission administration
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an easy-to-administer permissions interface for report-related permissions.
candidates.source_quote: The permissions need to be easy to administer.
candidates.priority_signals: Requested explicitly by Susan; emphasized as important

candidates.title: Role-based permission updates
candidates.statement: The system shall update a user's report-related permissions automatically based on their role when the user's role changes.
candidates.source_quote: If I change someone from "Staff" to "Manager," their report permissions should update automatically based on the role.
candidates.priority_signals: Explicitly requested by Susan

candidates.title: Pre-defined board reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide pre-defined reports for library boards that include the basic statistics required by the Georgia Annual Report.
candidates.source_quote: Pre-defined reports for library boards with basic statistics (Georgia Annual Report requirements).
candidates.priority_signals: Specifically tied to statutory reporting; included in summary

candidates.title: Activity metrics in reports
candidates.statement: The system shall include activity metrics in reports including checkouts, check-ins, holds placed, and holds filled.
candidates.source_quote: Activity reports showing traffic and volume of use - checkouts, check-ins, holds placed, holds filled.
candidates.priority_signals: Requested in original email and summary

candidates.title: Cross-tabulation capability
candidates.statement: The system shall support cross-tabulation of report metrics by terminal, branch, system, hour, age range, patron type, and patron location.
candidates.source_quote: Cross-tabulated per terminal, per branch, per system, per hour, per age range, per patron type, per patron location.
candidates.priority_signals: Listed explicitly as required for board/activity reports; included in summary

candidates.title: Transaction archive retention
candidates.statement: The system shall archive transaction data and retain it for X years as required by State Law.
candidates.source_quote: State law requires us to retain transaction data for X years
candidates.priority_signals: Cited as compliance requirement

candidates.title: Transaction archive privacy protection
candidates.statement: The system shall archive transactions in a way that protects patron privacy by not retaining personally identifiable information.
candidates.source_quote: patron privacy means we can't keep personally identifiable information
candidates.priority_signals: Cited as privacy requirement and legal constraint

candidates.title: Archive supports demographic statistics
candidates.statement: The system shall provide useful demographic statistics from the transaction archive while protecting patron privacy.
candidates.source_quote: while providing useful demographic statistics
candidates.priority_signals: Requested to balance compliance and analytics requirements

candidates.title: Show query selections with results
candidates.statement: The system shall display the query selection criteria alongside the query results.
candidates.source_quote: System provides query selections along with results.
candidates.priority_signals: Listed in original list and summary

candidates.title: Report queue position visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to see the position of their submitted report in the processing queue.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to see where your report is in the queue.
candidates.priority_signals: Multiple respondents emphasized importance; IT confirmed visibility would reduce help-desk calls

candidates.title: Number of reports ahead
candidates.statement: The system shall display how many reports are ahead of a user's submitted report in the queue.
candidates.source_quote: How many reports are ahead of theirs
candidates.priority_signals: Requested specifically by Dana; included in summary of queuing details

candidates.title: Report submission timestamp
candidates.statement: The system shall show the timestamp when the report was submitted.
candidates.source_quote: When their report was submitted
candidates.priority_signals: Requested by Dana and included in summary

candidates.title: Report status values
candidates.statement: The system shall show report status with values including waiting, running, completed, and failed.
candidates.source_quote: Status (waiting, running, completed, failed)
candidates.priority_signals: Requested explicitly; IT noted impact on help-desk calls

candidates.title: Report priority and prioritization controls
candidates.statement: The system shall display report priority and provide controls to prioritize reports so important reports can jump ahead in the queue.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to prioritize certain reports is crucial... should be able to jump ahead
candidates.priority_signals: Described as crucial by George; summarized as "PRIORITY" in consolidated summary

candidates.title: Admin ability to prioritize others' reports
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to elevate the priority of specific reports (for example, a director's board report) to move them ahead of other queued reports.
candidates.source_quote: A director's board report should be able to jump ahead of a staff member's ad-hoc query.
candidates.priority_signals: Example given by George; called crucial
